ruleDefinitions.name: Firewall Rule Deleted Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the removal of a port or application rule in the Windows Firewall configuration using netsh

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*firewall.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*delete\\ .*"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Dropbox\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*name\\=Dropbox.*")))
